The [[Destructive Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Destroyer Chest]], which spawns after defeating the [[Plague of Destruction]] in [[Raven's Point]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item shares the same [[skin]] as the [[Igneous Blade]].
